args.note: For the amm 316L material E_s = 193 GPa. The variational uniform-strain bound for a single isotropic elastic solid plus void gives C_eff <= phi C_s and hence E100_eff <= phi E_s (choose the solid's uniaxial-stress strain as an admissible trial strain, with free transverse relaxation). At phi <= 0.12, E100_eff <= 23.16 GPa < 25.1 GPa. Thus no geometry in any allowed family can meet the targets. Even this ideal upper bound requires phi >= 25.1/193 = 0.1300518, or 13.0052% solid; that necessary condition does not guarantee feasibility. No cell size is needed for this static impossibility proof; LPBF manufacturability was not evaluated.
